news.headline: Abivax shares down about 31% over three months, trading below key moving averages
news.summary: French market coverage notes the Paris-listed shares have lost roughly 31% over three months and remain below their moving averages, after breaking the EUR 76 support level on Nov 6. The weakness persists despite reiterated ~$175 analyst targets ahead of the year-end NDA.

news.headline: Piper Sandler raises Abivax price target to $175, keeps Overweight/Buy
news.summary: Piper Sandler lifted its target to $175, citing the obefazimod Phase 3 data package ahead of the planned NDA. The shares rebounded in early November after falling roughly 25-30% over the quarter.

news.headline: Abivax to Participate in Upcoming Fall Investor Conferences
news.summary: Management will appear at the Guggenheim Healthcare Innovation Conference (fireside chat Nov 10), the LifeSci Capital x Sofinnova summit in London (Nov 16), the German Equity Forum in Frankfurt (Nov 23) and Evercore ISI's healthcare conference (fireside chat Dec 2). These are the last scheduled public appearances before the year-end NDA target.

news.headline: Guggenheim reiterates Buy on Abivax with $175 target
news.summary: Guggenheim (and Piper Sandler the next day) reaffirmed Buy ratings around fresh obefazimod trial data presented in October, while the stock was hitting multi-month lows. Sell-side consensus remains 'Moderate Buy'.

news.headline: Abivax presents H1 2026 results: NDA planned for end of 2026, cash runway into Q4 2029, CMO succession
news.summary: Abivax reiterated its end-2026 NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis and said cash (after a ~$920M offering) funds operations into Q4 2029. Chief Medical Officer Fabio Cataldi will leave in Q4 2026 and be succeeded by Chris Rabbat; higher cash burn prompted some analyst estimate cuts and a ~4% share drop.

catalysts.label: Guggenheim Healthcare Innovation Conference fireside chat
catalysts.detail: Boston, 10:30-10:55am ET; possible color on NDA submission timing and launch preparation.

catalysts.label: German Equity Forum corporate presentation
catalysts.detail: Frankfurt, 11:40am-12:10pm CET (LifeSci Capital x Sofinnova summit in London on Nov 16 as well).

catalysts.label: Evercore ISI Healthcare Conference fireside chat
catalysts.detail: Miami, 7:55-8:15am ET; last scheduled appearance before the year-end NDA target.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial update
catalysts.detail: Date from Abivax's earlier 2026 financial calendar as reported; not re-confirmed in a recent release.

catalysts.label: NDA submission for obefazimod (UC)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided first NDA submission to the FDA by end of 2026, reiterated in July (pre-NDA meeting) and September (H1 results). Submission before the Mar-2027 call expiry is the key near-term event.

catalysts.label: FDA filing acceptance and PDUFA date
catalysts.detail: FDA typically decides on filing within ~60 days of submission and sets a PDUFA goal date; if submitted in December, acceptance would land around February-March 2027, close to the call's March 2027 expiry.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b topline in Crohn's disease (obefazimod)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided topline readout of the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial in mid-2027; after the Mar-2027 call expiry but a key second-indication driver.

pulse: Abivax has a complete positive Phase 3 package in ulcerative colitis (induction and Week-44 maintenance), constructive pre-NDA feedback and cash into Q4 2029, but the shares are down roughly 31% over three months on regulatory-timing worries and higher burn, with the ADR around $86-87 in early November and the Paris line below the EUR 76 support level since November 6, despite Piper Sandler and Guggenheim reiterating ~$175 targets. Next up are the Guggenheim fireside chat (Nov 10), Frankfurt (Nov 23) and Evercore (Dec 2), then the year-end NDA submission and FDA filing acceptance in early 2027 - the key catalysts for the Mar-2027 $120 call, which still needs a large rally to finish in the money.
